guarantees.claim: sp2v_sig is combinatorially assigned to a flattened version of key_init_we_ctrl: for each share index s and key register index i, sp2v_sig[s * NumRegsKey + i] equals key_init_we_ctrl[s][i].

formal.antecedent: s >= 0 && s < NumSharesKey && i >= 0 && i < NumRegsKey

formal_sketch.antecedent: s >= 0 && s < NumSharesKey && i >= 0 && i < NumRegsKey

security_implications: Signal key_init_we_ctrl is related to key initialization write enables. This chunk only flattens the control bits into sp2v_sig. Mis-indexing due to parameter misuse could theoretically enable writes to wrong key shares, but the assignment itself is deterministic and relies on correct NumSharesKey and NumRegsKey. No direct security vulnerability identified in this mapping.
